lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank, organized into approximately five primary horizontal rows. These clusters exhibit a uniform spatial distribution in the mid-body, becoming more linearly aligned as they progress toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a distinct checkerboard-like arrangement where the blobs serve as the primary vertices of the grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition with light-colored pixels on the superior edge and a deep shadow band on the inferior edge, extending from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the pectoral fin insertion displays a significantly higher density of smaller, low-diameter high-luminance points compared to the more sparse and larger-diameter grid pattern of the posterior flank.
